subjectOf.description: FortiGuard DLP ensures that proprietary intelligence and regulated information remain secure without the complexity of traditional, siloed products.
subjectOf.name: Deliver Real-Time Protection Against Data Exfiltration, Insider Threats, and Shadow AI with the FortiGuard DLP Service

subjectOf.description: The FortiGuard Attack Surface Security Service integrates with FortiGate Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFWs) and provides continuous, real-time visibility into security posture across the Fortinet Security Fabric.
subjectOf.name: Reduce Risk and Maintain Compliance with the FortiGuard Attack Surface Security Service

subjectOf.description: Optimized for FortiGate NGFWs, these curated service bundles help security and network teams protect their environments with layered, adaptive defense, whether at the branch, campus, data center, or in the cloud.
subjectOf.name: Get Comprehensive, Scalable Protection with FortiGuard AI-Powered Security Services Bundles for FortiGate Next-Generation Firewalls

subjectOf.description: The suite of FortiGuard AI-Powered Security Services delivers real-time multilayered, proactive defense to safeguard networks, applications, files, web traffic, data, devices, cloud workloads, and users from traditional and AI-driven attacks.
subjectOf.name: FortiGuard AI-Powered Security Services

subjectOf.description: FortiGate Subscription & FortGuard Bundles Ordering Guide
subjectOf.name: FortiGate Subscription & FortGuard Bundles Ordering Guide

subjectOf.description: SMBs need the same caliber of protections that enterprises do. FortiGuard AIPowered Security Services is developed and continually updated with the latest threat intelligence of FortiGuard Labs.
subjectOf.name: AI-Powered Threat Protection for Small and Midsize Businesses

subjectOf.description: Instead of forcing a choice between security and performance, the FortiGuard AI-Based Inline Malware Prevention Service blocks unknown files including zero-days and AI-driven threats inline and in real time.
subjectOf.name: Stop Zero-Day and AI-Driven Threats with the FortiGuard AI-Based Inline Malware Prevention Service

subjectOf.description: The FortiGuard DNS Filtering Service provides full visibility into DNS traffic while blocking high-risk domains. It protects against sophisticated DNS-based threats including DNS tunneling, DNS spoofing, dynamic DNS, and Domain Generation Algorithms (DGAs).
subjectOf.name: FortiGuard DNS Filtering Service Brief

subjectOf.description: Stop web-based threats by blocking URLs associated with malicious websites and webpages, including those used in phishing, credential theft, and malicious payloads, such as downloaders and ransomware.
subjectOf.name: FortiGuard URL Filtering Service Brief
